I am VERY impressed by qwen3 4B (q8q4 gguf version)
I usually test models reasoning using a few "not in any dataset" logic problems.

Up until the thinking models came along, only "huge" models could solve "some" of those problems in one shot.

Today I wanted to see how a heavily quantized (q8q4) small model as Qwen3 4B performed.

To my surprise, it gave the right answer and even the thinking was linear and very good.

text:
All hail Nemotron-4 the wise - the new king of logical reasoning
NVIDIA Nemotron-4 340B model finished running prompts from my farel-bench <url> benchmark this morning (it took about 21 hours to process all 450 prompts) and took first place among open-weight models with the score of 78.67 (% of correct answers).

Now I want to repeat the benchmark with added system prompt (for LLaMa-3 70B this significantly improved the result), but this would probably take 2-3 days. Also hopefully LLaMa-3 400B will be released soon and we will witness an interesting heavyweight fight between the two.
label: analysis
